items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I said, watch out, Blue... I told him to say, Walter Blue. That's Walter Blue you're talking.

ctx.x: I bet you didn't know that.

That's his real name. No, I didn't know it. Sun White. Well he live up on Long Street now, I believe. Back real quick. He was playing with them. I said, watch out, Blue. I said, Brown and Kelly's banger runs in today. You know what he said? He said, well, I'm going to toot this trumpet today. Brown and Kelly's nobody. I said, man, he cuddled us on the drum. We left him there and went down the fourth seat. It was hot that day, Fulton Thomas. We got a beer. It was all rain and wet. This from 6th Street to Fulton…
Yeah, Walter Blue, yes. Yeah, I know who you're talking about.
